item.title: Luc LeBlanc trial: Canadian trucker guilty of criminally negligent homicide in deaths of 3
item.description: KINGSTON, N.Y. — An Ulster County Court jury on Friday found a Canadian tractor-trailer driver guilty of three counts of criminally negligent homicide in connection with a 2020 crash on the state Thruway that killed three people. The eight-man, four-woman jury acquitted Luc LeBlanc, 67, of Salaberry-de-Valleyfield, Quebec, of three counts of manslaughter. Their verdict followed […]
